'''Barbara Fantechi''' is an Italian mathematician and Professor at the [[International School for Advanced Studies]]. Her research area is [[algebraic geometry]]. She is a member of the [[Accademia dei Lincei]].

==Early life and education==
Fantechi received her [[Laurea]] from the [[University of Pisa]] in 1988, with thesis ''Secanti di varietà proiettive e applicazioni''.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|title= Barbara Fantechi |publisher=Istituto Veneto di Scienze, Lettere ed Arti|work=Academics|url=https://www.istitutoveneto.it/flex/cm/pages/ServeBLOB.php/L/IT/IDPagina/1864 |access-date=2022-09-08 |language=it}}</ref><ref name=":1" /> Her doctoral advisor was Fabrizio [[Catanese surface|Catanese]].<ref name=":1">{{MathGenealogy|id=129279}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
Her research considers algebraic geometry.<ref>{{Citation |title=Barbara Fantechi: A classical view on derived algebraic geometry |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B8ygFG3kKJI |language=en |access-date=2022-09-08}}</ref> She has developed the mathematical theories that underpin [[algebraic stack]]s. Stacks were first introduced to understand the [[moduli space of curves]].<ref>{{Citation |last=Fantechi |first=Barbara |chapter=Stacks for Everybody |date=2001 |chapter-url=http://dx.doi.org/10.1007/978-3-0348-8268-2_20 |title=European Congress of Mathematics |pages=349–359 |place=Basel |publisher=Birkhäuser Basel |doi=10.1007/978-3-0348-8268-2_20 |isbn=978-3-0348-9497-5 |access-date=2022-09-08|chapter-url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |title=BIRATIONAL GEOMETRY AND MODULI SPACES. |date=2021 |publisher=SPRINGER NATURE |isbn=978-3-030-37116-6 |location=[S.l.] |oclc=1237354386}}</ref>

== Honours and awards ==
In 2018, Fantechi received the Prof. Luigi Tartufari award from the [[Accademia dei Lincei]].<ref name=":2">{{cite web|date=2018-06-22|title=Barbara Fantechi awarded by the Accademia dei Lincei|url=https://www.sissa.it/news/barbara-fantechi-awarded-accademia-dei-lincei|website=Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati|accessdate=7 April 2019}}</ref> She was awarded the [[Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|MSRI]] Chancellor's Professorship for 2017-2018, and spent a year at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=MSRI|title=Mathematical Sciences Research Institute|url=http://www.msri.org/|access-date=2021-06-07|website=www.msri.org}}</ref> In 2022, Fantechi was the first woman mathematician to become a member of the [[Accademia dei Lincei]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-08-03 |title=Barbara Fantechi appointed Correspondent Member of Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei |url=https://www.sissa.it/news/barbara-fantechi-appointed-correspondent-member-accademia-nazionale-dei-lincei |access-date=2022-09-08 |website=Scuola Internazionale Superiore di Studi Avanzati |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Fellows in News {{!}} Accademia Nazionale dei Lincei |url=https://www.lincei.it/en/news-soci |access-date=2022-09-08 |website=www.lincei.it |language=en}}</ref>
